next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-1 must reference a data item whose usage is DISPLAY."; 2023: "— a boolean data item, — a national data item, … that is not subordinate to a strongly-typed group item". 1985 allows only usage DISPLAY items. 2023 adds boolean and national items, and refuses some display items: those under strongly-typed groups, and strongly-typed or variable-length groups.
